title: InfoDiffusion: Representation Learning Using Information Maximizing Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2306.08757v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While diffusion models excel at generating high-quality samples, their latent variables typically lack semantic meaning and are not suitable for representation learning. Here, we propose InfoDiffusion, an algorithm that augments diffusion models with low-dimensional latent variables that capture high-level factors of variation in the data. InfoDiffusion relies on a learning objective regularized with the mutual information between observed and hidden variables, which is designed to improve latent space quality and to prevent the latents from being ignored by expressive diffusion-based decoders. Empirically, we find that InfoDiffusion learns disentangled and human-interpretable latent representations that are competitive with state-of-the-art generative and contrastive methods, while retaining the high sample quality of diffusion models. translated_title: InfoDiffusion：使用信息最大化扩散模型进行表示学习
translated_abstract: 虽然扩散模型在生成高质量样本方面表现出色，但其潜变量通常缺乏语义意义，不适合用于表示学习。在此，我们提出了InfoDiffusion，这是一种通过低维潜变量来增强扩散模型的算法，这些潜变量能够捕获数据中的高级变化因素。InfoDiffusion依赖于一个以观测变量与隐藏变量之间的互信息进行正则化的学习目标，旨在提升潜空间的质量，并防止潜变量被表达能力强的基于扩散的解码器所忽略。实验表明，InfoDiffusion学习到的解耦且人类可解释的潜表示与最先进的生成式和对比式方法相比具有竞争力，同时保留了扩散模型的高样本质量。我们的方法能够对生成图像的属性进行操控，并具有辅助……的潜力。
tldr: InfoDiffusion通过互信息正则化学习目标，使扩散模型获得低维、解耦且可解释的潜变量表示，在保持高质量图像生成的同时实现了有效的表示学习和图像属性操控。
en_tdlr: InfoDiffusion enables diffusion models to learn low-dimensional, disentangled, and interpretable latent representations through mutual information regularization, achieving effective representation learning and image attribute manipulation while maintaining high sample generation quality.
